status: FROZEN — remediation experiments may only execute against this plan. No change after execution starts.
sequence_position: After P3 Overall Gate + P3 evidence freeze + 5 binding constraints; before targeted experiments.
ordering_rule: Held-out separation FIRST (all future data is born separated), then diversity/walls, then scale, then economics. Scale without diversity is explicitly forbidden by the frozen P3-D rule.
guardrails: NO TRAINING at any point in this plan (same hard guardrail as P3-D, enforced by the same tests).
All new trajectories carry frozen-verifier labels; no human-graded or model-graded labels.
Held-out cases are never train-eligible and are scored only by frozen verifiers.
Every experiment checkpoints per case/sample and is resumable; timeouts recorded, never scored.
No benchmark or bar changes after results: bars for re-measurement are the frozen P3-D thresholds.

items.title: Cut and freeze the held-out split
items.experiment: Author a HELDOUT spec: new cases never used in any prior run, disjoint case IDs/prompts from all training-eligible sets, frozen verifier scoring only. Freeze with hashes before any R-2/R-3/R-4 generation.
items.acceptance: HELDOUT artifact exists; CI test proves zero case/prompt overlap with every training-eligible set; split frozen under tag.
items.remeasure: d8_heldout flips to PASS when the assessor finds the frozen split.

items.title: Add a second, REAL design family
items.experiment: Select a real open-source RTL block family; inject width/bug variants under the frozen repair.verify gate; pre-register case list and widths before generation. Human decision required for block selection.
items.acceptance: >= 1 real design family with >= 20 verifier-gated cases across >= 2 widths; case list pre-registered and frozen.
items.remeasure: d2_diversity design-family count rises (needs R-2a as well for full PASS).

items.title: Add a third task family
items.experiment: Stand up the R5 task family end-to-end (shares corpus with R-3): frozen prompts, frozen verifier, pre-registered cases.
items.acceptance: >= 1 third task family with >= 20 verifier-labeled trajectories.
items.remeasure: d2_diversity task-family count rises; combined with R-2b gives full PASS.

items.title: Build the third-wall trajectory corpus
items.experiment: Collect full generation → verification trajectories for the R5 wall (same corpus as R-2a) with frozen labels; include both passing and failing trajectories.
items.acceptance: >= 20 complete R5 trajectories with verifier labels, prompts/outputs/verdicts logged.

items.title: Run the validated recipe at scale
items.experiment: Run strong-model-inside-structured-pipeline (the P3-C Q1 recipe) over the expanded case pool (R-2b + R-2a) until verifier-positive trajectories >= 1000, across cases, widths, and models. Held-out cases excluded by construction (R-1).
items.remeasure: d1_scale flips to PASS (d3_balance must remain PASS — rebalancing runs under the same recipe if positives drown).

items.title: Record the training-economics memo
items.experiment: Once R-1..R-4 move: estimate GPU cost at projected scale vs expected capability gain x generality; record as a memo artifact. No training spend is authorized by the memo itself.
items.acceptance: Memo exists with costed options and an explicit positive/negative-EV conclusion.

re_measure_rule: After each remediation item completes, rerun scripts/p3d_readiness_v2.py (frozen thresholds). Cleared = dimension PASS. Any remaining FAIL → iterate on its item. All 10 PASS → Training Readiness Gate: a fresh verdict file, then a SEPARATE training authorization (P4) — never training here.
method: Plan only. No experiment executed, no trajectory generated, no model called in writing this plan.
